svg.title: Japan at a glance
svg.desc: An editorial infographic with a stylized map labeling Tokyo, Yokohama, Osaka and Nagoya; an introduction to Japan; nominal GDP for every year from 2015 through 2024; a population composition donut chart; and six places to visit. All financial and population figures are reproduced from the supplied brief. Population categories are not presented as an independently verified census estimate.
svg.metadata: Static vector infographic. Dimensions: 1200 × 1800. No JavaScript, raster images, animation or external rendering assets. Map adapted from Natural Earth 1:110m geography, with a stylized island separation. Destination context: https://www.japan.travel/en/destinations/ . GDP, current US$ trillions: 2015 4.44; 2016 5.00; 2017 4.93; 2018 5.04; 2019 5.12; 2020 5.05; 2021 5.04; 2022 4.26; 2023 4.21; 2024 4.03. Supplied population grouping: Japanese 97.5%; Chinese 0.6%; Vietnamese 0.4%; South Korean 0.3%; Other 1.2%.

g.text: Cities, culture and the landscapes in between.

text.tspan: Japan lies along the eastern edge of Asia.

From Hokkaido’s snowy landscapes to Okinawa’s subtropical islands, Japan pairs mountain
scenery with historic neighborhoods and energetic cities. Regional food, seasonal festivals
and an extensive rail network give each journey a different rhythm.
